subpoints.criteria: 1) Two OPs and two Security personnel must be from different agencies & present during opening and closing.

2) All names, timings & signatures must be correctly recorded in register. Details will be verified with Biometric or Face Punching data available in the system. Variance is not allowed. Duty Manager to punch first after opening the store followed by others reporting on 1st Shift. Similar process to be followed during closing but in this case Manager to punch last. Opening & closing process activities as detailed above must be followed even if store is working in the night shift for receiving, maintenance, stock take, etc.
3) Location of Trolleys, Baskets, Bag in Bags & Crates to be maintained daily in Location wise Assets Register and total should be recorded in the opening & closing register.
1) Counting of Trolleys,Baskets, Crates and Bag in Bags must be done by different security personnel in the morning and night and record total counts in the register on daily basis.

2) Trolleys/ Baskets & Bag in Bags sent out for repairs via returnable gate pass must reflect in physical quantities recorded in register.  This is also applicable for green bags repairing, cartridge refilling in the store premises and returned on the same day.
3) All entries made by Facility staff in the register to be checked for accuracy & signed by Duty Manager on daily basis.

1) This register is maintained at staff entry to record all purchases made by staff while on lunch break or after duty hours. All details such as name of staff, facility on duty, bill no, amount, no of articles, etc  must be entered by Facility after checking the articles. Staff sign & Facility Sign to be done for each entry made in the register.
2)  All staff billing to be done in designated POS nominated by Store.
3) Managers to check accuracy and sign after the last entry to ensure no more billing is done for the same date post their signature.
1) All couriers received in the store must be entered in this register immediately.  Facility staff receiving the courier will enter receiving date, time & sign in the register.

2)  All Couriers must be handover immediately to the adressee & signature of the adressse must be obtained in the register. Handover date & time must also be recorded in the register. If any addressee is absent, courier must be handed over to Duty Manager and signature of Managers to be obtained. Such couriers will be handed over to the addressee, on the next working day, by Duty Managers. Duty Managers to ensure no couriers are left behind at Facility table.

1) All Attendance Registers of 3P Staff; D Mart Staff; Mis punching register, Visitor's register; HO / RO staff;  AMC contractors register; Night working vendors register must all be available on Facility table at Staff Entry.

2) Only Signatures to be done by all, without any exception, while entering the store & while leaving the store from Staff Entry after duty hours. Entries in Mis punch register must be done by Staff immediately in presence of facility staff on duty. Facility staff must sign after checking the details entered by staff.

1) All empty Cartons, Plastic, HDPE Bags must be carried by Staff/Promoters from respective department and checked by Facility Staff at Staff Entry. Scrap from Godown must be brought by HK Staff on duty. Stores where scrap is dumped from top floor must ensure only  facility staff should check & dispose the scrap from the assigned area. In stores where scrap gets dumped in vendor's pick up area, Vendor must collect scrap in presence of facility staff to ensure articles if found in the scrap, is collected and entered in the register. This will take care of reducing the pilferage loss.
2) All scrap to be transferred to another empty trolley by Facility Staff. Any articles found in the scrap must be recorded in this register with article details, name of the accompanying Staff etc.

3) Such articles must be verified  by Godown Officer and handed over to Core / Non core Officer & sent back to sections. Signatures to be done in the register by Godown Officer, Core/ Non core Officers respectively.
4) Duty Manager to check for accuracy & sign in the register. Duty Managers to ensure that such incidents are not repeated.

1) All Dmart & 3P personnel entering through Staff Entry must enter their names in this register & remember the serial no. as the number will vary everyday. This is to maintain a count of our people inside the store during any emergency.
2) While going out of the stores after duty hours the names should be cancelled by staff themselves in the register. Facility staff should not cancel entries in the register.

1) Gate Pass Register for ASL & AFPPL must be maintained by Facility on duty at Staff Entry and all entries will be made in serial order and the original Gate Pass must be filed in serial order by Facility staff. Originals of cancelled Gate Pass must also be filed by Facility in this file in the same order and correct entries must be made in the register.
2) Facility to physically check all articles going out of store, collect original Gate Pass from Vendor, sign and affix rubber stamp and record Out Time in Gate Pass  as per clock.
3) Details such as Gate Pass In time, Out time, Vendor Name, Quantity etc must be entered  in the Gate Pass Register after debit is sent out of store and signed by Facility staff on duty.
4) Managers signing on the Gate Pass must also sign in the Register before EOD. Manager signature must be done after checking entries made by Facility Staff in the register.

title: RETURNABLE GATE PASS FILE AND REGISTER

subpoints.criteria: 1) Returnable Gate Pass Register must be maintained by Facility at Staff Entry and all entries will be made in serial order by Facility Staff on duty and the original of Returnable Gate Pass must be filed in serial order by Facility staff. Originals of all cancelled Returnable Gate Pass must also be filed by Facility in this file in the same order and details must be entered in the register.
2) Facility staff must physical check all articles going out of store, collect original of Returnable Gate Pass , sign and affix rubber stamp and record Out Time in Gate Pass as per clock.
3) Details such as Gate Pass In time, Out time, Vendor Name, Quantity, etc must be entered  in the Gate Pass Register after articles are sent out of store and signed by Facility staff on duty.
4) Managers signing on the Gate Pass must also sign in the Register before EOD. Manager signature must be done after checking entries made by Facility Staff.

5) When articles covered under Returnable Gate Pass are received, a rubber stamp with "Returnable Received, Date of return, Godown Officer Sign, Facility Sign must be recorded. This rubber stamp must be affixed on original copy of Returnable Gate Pass and Returnable Gate Pass Register.
6) Duty Manager to sign in the Returnable Gate Pass register after verifying all details of the articles received.

1) All vehicle nos to be entered in Vehicle Inward Register by Facility Staff. Only one vehicle inward register to be maintained for local vendors, DC Vehicles, Transport bundles and Scrap Vendors. Vehicle nos entered in Gate Pass and Vehicle Inward Register must be same.

2) Security must enter vehicle no. on reverse of PO & handover PO & Bill to vendor. Vendor bills should not be accumulated at Facility desk or Godown. Responsibility of keeping the bills rests with vendor till receiving starts.
3) Vehicle inward register to record Vehicle In time; Gate Pass OUT TIME, Receiving start time & Vehicle Out time. All timings to be recorded correctly as per the clock.
4) Manager to check for accuracy & sign in each page of the register.

1) Registers to be maintained Section wise : Tea/ Biscuits/ Ready To Eat/ Masala/ Cold Drinks/ Ghee/ Oil/ Grocery/ Cosmetics/ Detergents/ Chiller Items/ Freezer Items/ Home Care, etc ( Allocations of Sections may differ from Store to Store based on Store layout). Daily Updation of all Stock Out articles including Focus, Permanent offer, Private Label articles, etc to be done by SA irrespective of their shifts. All articles which are not found by SA during any shifts, for refilling will be entered in this register which will be maintained at Purchase Table. After updating SA should sign in the register.  Purchase Officer should not provide printouts of system stock to staff for entering in the register. Process auditor will use the master sheet to check entries in stock out register for any date and any section. No variance to be observed by the audit team.
2) All entries made by SA must be checked by Floor Officers.  Floor Officer must check and sign the register.

3) Purchase officer to check system quantities & enter quantity for stocks available in the store and inform Floor Officer to refill the same to avoid any sale loss. Purchase Officer to note articles which are not available in the store and release POs and enter valid PO no & date in comments. For DC articles, Purchase Officer to get  PR generated and enter valid PR no & date and follow up with DC for stocks. Purchase Officer to refer DC stock statement provided by Integration Team on daily basis. After mentioning appropriate remarks purchase officer should sign in register by 12 noon.

4) Post Purchase Officer signature, all stock out articles identified by SA working in subsequent shifts must be entered in the register and such entries are to be entered under next date. Entries in stock out register is a continuous process.
5) Duty Manager to check & sign in register after completing the task.
1) Purchase Officer to maintain daily Top 1000 list provided by APMs on monthly basis. Action taken against the stock out articles to be mentioned - PO/PR number & date of PO/PR

2) Purchase Officer to use the master sheet to check entries in stock out registers after updating stocks from MC.09 report. Master sheet to be maintained date wise and System Stock & Stock in days to be updated in relevant date column daily. In absence of Purchase Officers, On Sundays & Holidays, duty Managers to update the MC.09 data in the Master Sheet.  Purchase Officer to inform Floor Officer regarding any articles (from Top 1000) which are not entered by SA in the register.

1) Purchase Officer to maintain datewise checklist for Best 100 + 5 PL Focus packs for the month as per recommended format. Checklist should not contain LP column. Checklist to record stocks as per MC.09, SP as recommended by Category & PL team, Correct Communication board to be maintained datewise. Purchase officer to check during floorwalk & sign on daily basis.

2) To improve availability of focus article sometimes changes are made by RCM. Checklist to be updated for any corrections as approved by Regional Category Manager. Current updated checklist to be used by Purchase/ floor officers. Floor Officer to check & sign.
3) Duty/Dept Manager to check implementation on floor and sign the checklist on daily basis.

1) Purchase officer to maintain Private Label checklist for the month as provided by Commercial Marketing Team from HO. SP of all articles to match with monthly list sent by Commercial Marketing Team. SP for all articles based on PO must be manually updated every day. Any changes to be routed through Commercial Marketing Team only. Any changes received from PL Team must be immediately implemented on floor. Purchase officer to check & sign on daily basis.

2) Stocks to be updated as per MC.09. Facings, right alignment etc to be maintained as per Visibility Guidelines provided by PL Execution Team. Facings on the shelf to be maintained as per the PL checklist (eg - 1:2, 50:50 etc) guidelines.   "ONLY" boards or "BOGO" boards suggested by Commercial Marketing Team to be mainained displaying MRP for the benefit of the customers. Floor Officer to check & sign.
3) Manager to check implementation on floor and sign the checklist on daily basis confirming action taken.

1) PNM follow up by Purchase must result in reduction of pending bills and prompt settlement of vendor bills. Details will be provided by Concurrent Audit Team for the completed month. If ageing is > 30 days or status quo is maintained the score will be zero. Duty Managers to check and ensure all PNM bills for Core & Non Core are cleared within 30 days through rigorous follow up with Purchase Officers in Stores/ Category Managers for Non Core in HO or RO. Duty Managers to follow up with Non core category team in RO / HO and settle vendor's bills. Process Auditors must check PNM file at Accounts and ensure no bills are unpaid for > 30 days. This is to ensure all rthose bills which are missed out by concurrent auditors are also checked and reported.

1) Purchase Officer remarks after first floor walk in the morning detailing action plan for floor and GRN. Eg., Refilling/Board/ Facings/ FIFO/ Expiry/ Hygiene/Missing Barcodes, etc. must be entered in the floor walk register in serial order. Purchase Officer to mention all articles including Focus Packs, Private Label, Permanent Offers, Seamless articles etc. Floor walk summary to be completed by Purchase Officer after first floor walk. Purchase officer will handover the register to Floor & GRN to complete the floor walk points.

2) After completion of floor walk points by Floor & GRN, they should sign the register. Purchase Officer must complete 2nd floor walk and record status of completion in the register. Purchase officer to highlight pending items in the register to enable Managers to follow up and complete the unfinished task. Details will be completed in the floor walk summary after 2nd floor walk by Purchase Officer. Purchase officer to check & sign the register on daily basis.

3) Duty Manager to mention remarks on "Pending Points" in Floor Walk Summary : Duty Manager must check & confirm completion of pending points by Floor & GRN and then sign the register. Process Auditor will check comments of Duty Manager in the floor walk summary. 100% of the task must be completed by Floor & GRN on daily basis. Duty Manager to ensure summary must be maintained in the suggested format.

4)Duty Manager to check all skus in top 200 as per the revised list shared from HO on a monthly basis. Display check - 15 Sku in best 100 & 25 SKUs in best 1000, from 4 different categories to be checked on a daily basis.

1) Availability of all Best 100 + 5 PL articles to be maintained as per category recommendations throughout the month. For all DC stock out articles Process Auditor will check availability in DC stock statement ( Provided by DC Integration Team) maintained by Purchase Officer. Process Auditor will check and enter stock quantity in DC in their reports.
2) Correct Communication board for SP/Offer of all Best 100 + 5PL articles to be maintained as per category recommendations throughout the month.

3) Secondary visibility - Check visibility implementation of  Best 100 offers + 5 PL articles on floor. Maximising secondary visibility through floor stacks, TOT end caps, other end caps and other assets like dump bins, three tier bins to be done and checked by Dept Manager, basis the execution guidelines shared with the store on monthly basis.

1) GRF to be routed through Purchase. Purchase will provide vendor name, vendor code and check for write off; Ullage; Non Debitable & GST articles. Purchase to resolve GST related issues to avoid any wrong debits by godown. Reverse PO  to be made on the same date of MDBN (TRIPLICATE).

2) Debit process should not be followed for write off or Ullage articles. Delinked/Delisted articles should not be cancelled from Manual Debit Notes made by Godown. All articles in the Manual Debit Note will be pending till link is opened. Such links to be opened with rigorous follow up with category team and PO to be made. For all delinked or GST related articles, Purchase should retain the duplicate copy of Manual Debit Note for reverse PO, till the issues are resolved. Post debit PO, Purchase Officer must inform Category Team to delink the articles in the system to avoid any PO generation in future.

1) Promoters Attendance Register must be maintained at Purchase table. All Promoters reporting for duty will sign in the register. Any long absence must be informed to HR Officer to take appropriate action. Only Active Promoters name must be entered in the register every month. Names of Absentees of previous month should not be entered in the next month.

1) All SRT settlements to be done with customers after obtaining the Product & Original Bill & verifying  Bill details like store Name, Date of Bill, Amount, Barcode no., articles & quantities etc. If customer is unable to produce original bill or Original Bill already submitted, SRT must be done after verifying bill details in the system in presence of Duty Manager. Duty Manager to authenticate the same by mentioning "Bill details verified in system" in SRT Register. Duplicate bills must be generated for SRT Purpose. Only Managers will decide to reject any claims of customers. SRT Staff & Officers should not return the customers from SRT, other than for returns which are not acceptable as per policy.

2) SRT person can do SRT in his login for all Bills within 7days. For all Bills > 7days upto 1 month SRT to be done by Manager in his login. For all Bills > 1 month AM approval to be obtained immediately and pending SRT amounts to be settled in 24 hrs with assistance from R Soft back end team. Such timely settlements of bills will result in better customer satisfaction.

3) All entries to be made immediately in register after SRT settlement in system. SRT amounts for more than Rs 500 to be authorised by Duty Managers and name of Manager must be recorded in remarks column in SRT register. All articles returned by customers must be entered in SRT register. Daily Updation in SRT register to be done in serial order. Settlements of CFL & Warranty articles which are more than 1 month, SRT no. will be entered in the register as per SRT done in the system. For all such SRT done in the system, SRT nos , date , Reason for return as per SRT chit, Quantities, etc must be entered correctly. No wrong entries must be made in the SRT register. Customer details to be entered in the register & customer signature on SRT Register to be obtained for all returns (Double swipe/Quality Issues/Defective articles etc can be exempted). Appropriate reasons from the drop down provided for Sale returns must be entered in the register.
4) SRT Cashiers who are assigned duty  should only sign in the register. Pagewise totals in register will help to tally the amounts during closing of SRT.

5) Each entry in register to be signed by Manager present during closing of shifts. All products to be checked by Manager at the end of each shift & are to be returned to racks immediately. Comment by duty Manager "All SKUs Checked and found correct;  All articles are returned back to section" must be entered in SRT register during closing of each shifts or during SRT check at frequent intervals as practiced by stores.

1) SRT Chits to be generated immediately for all Returns during settlement with customers. Original bills must be submitted by customers. This is as per our return policy. Original Bills to be attached with SRT Chits for verification purpose. ( Bills of CFL & all  warranty articles  can be exempted.) If Original Bill is not available with Customer, Manager can authorise Sales Return at their descretion after verifying the bill details in the system and ensuring geniuneness of the return. In such cases Duplicate Bill should be generated by Duty Manager and attached to the SRT Chits.  Summary printout to be attached with SRT chits on daily basis. Auditor will check the printouts and the SRT chits for all entries for correctness.
2) Customer signature on SRT Chit to be obtained for all returns (Double swipe/Quality Issues/Defective articles etc can be exempted).
3) SRT Cashiers who are assigned duty should sign on SRT chit during their shifts.
4) All SRT Chits must be signed by Manager after checking Original/Duplicate Bills, barcodes, Reason for Return, articles & quantities etc.

1) SRT closing to be done 3 times or 4 times a day as per store operation timings. Each SRT cashier to spend 4 hrs at SRT & 4 hrs at POS. If only Part Time Cashiers are available in the store, they should be working either in SRT or POS.  Such cashiers  must be rotated in SRT or POS on different days. eg: If a Part Time Cashier is working on Monday in SRT, he will be deployed on POS on tuesday, wednesday etc. Cash Officers to ensure allotment of SRT must be made in the morning and should be a daily activity. Allotment of SRT counter should not be informed in advance to cashiers.

2) Cash Officers should ensure cashiers to work on their own Log In & Password.  Login IDs for new joinees to be obtained immediately with HR & R Soft assistance. Cash Officers must ensure to rotate cashiers and Packers also on different days different combination of cashier & packer to be made.

3) Opening balance at the beginning of shift to be entered by Cash Officer in the system for SRT Cashiers IDs. For Manager Closing also Opening balance to be entered in system. Manager closing, if any, must also be done at the end of Shifts.

4) Deductions must be calculated correctly. Rate difference & Amounts paid for CFL/LED/Warranty articles  should not be added to physical cash. All pending SRT amounts will be shown as short in SRT closing denominationwise report. Summary format to be updated correctly for Physical Cash and SRT totals at the close of each shift. Both manual calculations and system amounts must be tallied.

5) All closing reports to be generated Cashierwise during shift change of Cashiers including the SRT Summary, Cashier handover statement, Denominationwise closing balance with excess or short report, Rate Difference / IOU collected from accounts, 1% deduction amounts etc. For Manager Closing also same process to be followed. If in any shift there are no sales returns, closing must be done by entering the denominations

6) Subsequent shift cashier will continue entering the SRT nos in the same serial order in the register. During closing while entering the summary details, amount paid out of SRT for each shift must be tallied correctly shiftwise/cashierwise.

7) Cash Officers to collect SRT amounts from handover at the end of each shift & handover to next cashier before start of their shifts. This will ensure full SRT amount will be available at the beginning of all shifts. This will also avoid collecting IOU from Accounts.

1) Deleted items must be checked daily by Cash Officer 30 mts before closing shifts of Cashiers. Report to be generated Cashier wise and must be used to check articles in the crates. High value articles are to be deleted by Cashier after informing Cash Officer on duty. High value, Chiller & Freezer articles to be immediately sent to the respective sections after informing the Cash Officer. Any article deleted by cashier after checking by Cash Officer should be manually entered by Cash Officer in the same sheet with articles details & quantities. This must match with one page summary report generated during store closing.
2) Any unbilled articles should not be accumulated at POS. Articles lying in impulse should not be deposited in crates of cashiers.

3) All articles must be tallied with the report and Cash Officer must note down any variance in the reports & all articles must be returned back to respective sections. For unaccounted variance, Cashiers to meet Duty Manager before leaving for the day. Such practices will help to reduce any mismatches .

4) One page summary to be printed at day end detailing cashierwise transactions for the day. Name of Cashier, Shift details, POS no & Petti No to be entered in the register while handing over POS in the beginning of Shifts. One page summary can be generated for the completed month and data can be used to select Star of the Month
5) Manager to do surprise checks  on floor and sign the register.

1) 1% deductions to be made for all bills paid by Credit or Debit cards as per return policy. For quality issues, damaged articles, double swipe, wrong scanning, defective articles, rebilling, UPI payments, etc 1% will not be deducted. 1% deduction can be waived off to avoid any customer issues after Managers meet the customers personally. Such decisions will be solely based on Manager's discretion .

2) Details must be recorded in the suggested format as & when amount is collected from customers. Cash Officer must check entries  shift wise and 1% amount to be tallied with 1% amount entered in the closing summary sheet for each shift. Cash Officer to check & sign the register on shift basis.

3) In exceptional cases like quality issues, damaged articles, double swipe, wrong scanning, defective articles, rebilling, UPI payments, etc 1% will not be deducted. But entries to be made in 1% deductions register and remarks to be entered only for ZERO 1% deductions. For cash or UPI payments entries should not be made in 1% deduction register.
4) 1% Amounts collected from customers must be settled with accounts within 24 hrs. (Weekly off & holidays being an exception). Accounts to sign with date & time after settlement with Srt.
5) Manager to check & sign with date in the register confirming transaction with Accounts.

1) Rate Difference must be settled immediately after acknowledging our mistakes with customers, for all wrong communication boards. Rate Difference issues should not be settled through Sale Return.  All Rate Differences will be settled only after removing the wrong boards from the section by cash officer and retaining the same at SRT for verification. Any Online customer complaints received from HO regarding wrong boards/Price, marks will be deducted here.
2) All columns like customer name, signature & Contact nos.to be entered in the register and signatures to be obtained.

3) Cash Officer to mention "Rate Difference paid" in the bill against those articles. For all such cases Rate Difference paid in that respective date should be checked from the register. This will help in recovering the rate differences paid earlier. This is to avoid paying the full amount in SRT for any returns.

4) Communication boards for Rate differences settled must be verified by Cash Officer next day to ensure that proper boards are displayed. This is to avoid repeat of same mistakes on floor and paying Rate Difference on the same articles again.
5) This Rate Difference settlement with accounts to be done within 24 hrs. (Weekly off & holidays being an exception). Accounts to sign with date & time after settlement with Srt.
6) Manager to check & sign with date in the register confirming transaction with Accounts.

1) All Free Items to be maintained at SRT will be handed over by Godown Receiving Person to Cash Officer and details must be entered in this register immediately. Details will be checked and tallied with Free Item Register in Godown. Manufacturing Date, Expiry Date, Removal Date to be recorded correctly in this register. This register to be used to track expiry in case of food items. This activity to be done in the beginning of the month to track those Free Items which expire during that month. Same Cash Officer receiving Free Items from Godown should only sign the register.

2) All free items ( with or without barcodes ) must be covered by blank stickers. This is to avoid Free Item from scanning, debiting and also can be easily retrieved from mother racks and stored at Free Item Area. "Free Items/articles. Not for Sale" board to be prominently displayed in the Free Item Area. All Free items attached with Mother product should be kept at mother rack as it is. In such case Cash officer to ensure barcodes of free items are not scanned at POS. Such Free item entries will not be made in register maintained at SRT.

3) All free items to be handed over by Packers to customers after billing and the same must be noted in the bill for easy identification & to avoid any customer complaints later. Any Free Items disposed due to damages, expiry, etc will result Zero marks here. If any free article is handed over to customers at a later date, scoring will be zero
4) Manager to check implementation on floor and sign the register.

1) All CFL/LED bulbs, tubes etc not working & which are under warranty period and available in our stock, must be replaced after entering the same bill details on the replaced article ( Store Code, Bill No & Date, Warranty period, etc). Customer details to be recorded in the register and the damaged article to be handed over to Non core officer for further action. Non Core Officer to sign in register after receipt of the same. Manager to check & sign the register confirming action taken.

2) All CFL/LED bulbs, tubes etc not working & which are under warranty period and are out of stock must be settled immediately by cash in SRT. For all bills more than 30 days, AM approval to be obtained immediately and amounts to be settled in 24 hrs with assistance from R Soft back end team.
1)  Cash officer to enter correct details while handing over premix, cones, Popcorn, Kwality Walls, etc to cashiers on shift basis. Cashiers to be rotated at Softy counter regularly.
2) Manager to check & sign the register confirming action taken.

1) All Opening & Closing activities to be completed as per SOP & same must be recorded in register on daily basis. AFPPL Counters must be operational as per store opening & closing timings. Cash Team must Focus  on maintaining hygiene as per FSSAI guidelines throughout the activities.
2) Manager to check & sign in the register separately for opening & Closing.

1) Left over premix & popcorn to be weighed in bizerba and 2 stickers to be generated for each variant. One sticker to be affixed on the left over package as per variant and 2nd sticker to be handed over to Godown officer to affix on the disposal register maintained at godown. Damaged cones and left over premix/popcorn of each variant must be handed over to Godown Officer for disposal process.
2) Duty Manager to check &  sign on all stickers generated for disposal.

1) All Duplicate Bills to be generated by Duty Managers by using their own Login ID &  Password. All Duplicate Bills generated must be recorded immediately in register with Customer details  & their signatures must be obtained in register in presence of the same Manager. Manager authorising printing of duplicate bills must also sign in the register at the same time. After completing the transactions, Manager must log out of the system before leaving SRT. Manager to ensure Duplicate bills are handed over to customer after affixing the Exit stamp. Duplicate bills should not be generated in one lot during closing.

2) Details to be updated and tallied with system entries daily. Number of duplicate bills made during previous month /  period will be recorded in the report in absolute nos in the same serial order of printing and checked with system report which is printed on monthly basis.

3) Area Managers to approve log in for New Managers joining the store. For Visiting Managers from other stores, area manager must authorise them to use their own Log In credentials for this store also. This is to avoid misuse of login Id & password.

4) Wrong reasons for Printer problems, Rolls getting over should not be reasons for generating duplicate bills.  Sometimes customers request for bills to obtain reimbursements. Duplicate bills for such cases can be printed & are at Manager's discretion. For hardware issues, complaints must be locked in system immediately; both POS ID and  INC no. to be entered in the register. Wrong reasons for Printer issues are monitored at HO and report will be used to penalise the store if they raise wrong complaints.

1) All Lost & Found articles to be recorded in the register by SRT person immediately after receipt of the same. All Details like Product Description, Location where found & Name & signature of person who found the article must be recorded in the register.
2) Customer Details of Claimant person of any Lost & found article with proper ID proof & claim form to be filled & kept for verification.

3) As per policy guidelines all unclaimed articles, other than cards,must be retained in SRT for 7 days & after 7th day hand over to Accounts for safe custody. All types of cards will be handed over to Accounts Officer on day 1 as per new SOP dated 13.03.2024. Accounts officer to sign with date after receiving the articles.
4) All unclaimed articles which are sold in our store are to be entered in the register and sent back to racks immediately.
5) Manager to check & sign the register confirming action taken.

1) All Leftover Baggages of Customers to be recorded in the register by SRT person immediately on receipt of the same. All Details like Product Description, Name & signature of facility staff to be recorded in the register.
2) Customer Details of Claimant person of any such article with proper ID proof & claim form to be filled & kept for verification.

3) As per policy guidelines all unclaimed articles must be retained in SRT for 7 days & after 7th day hand over to Accounts for safe custody. Accounts officer to sign with date after receiving the articles.
4) Manager to check &  sign the register confirming action taken.

1) Cash Deposit Register  :  Denominations to be updated daily before cash handover. Same denomination must be entered in the pay in slip by Jr Accounts Officer. Sr Accounts Officer, Bank Person & Duty Manager all must sign in cash room daily after cash hand over process is completed.

2) Different persons must be nominated to check & deposit cash. Person preparing the pay in slip for bank must sign as "Checked by" and Sr Accts Officer present during handover must sign as "Deposited by. When only one Accounts personnel is available, Sr Cash Officer on duty can sign as "Deposited By".
3) Cash Deposit Register for AFPPL/RHRL (Pharmacy)to be maintained regularly as per the frequency of deposits of that store. Cash not deposited should be counted & kept seperately for next pickup.

1) Daily summary sheet of Petty Cash transactions opening and closing balance with physical denominations to be checked & signed by Manager. Pettycash summary with narration to be printed on the same day during closing.

2) Petty Cash vouchers to be signed by Recipient (person receiving the money), Maker (person preparing the voucher), Checker (Sr. Accounts officer present in the store). In Case of stores where only single accounts officer is available on a particular day, then the accounts officer who is present in the store & preparing the voucher should sign on "Checked By" option. In the "Prepared By" option accounts officer will mention "Absent". Supportings to be signed by Managers. Store Manager to countersign on vouchers which are approved by Duty Managers in their absence. Supportings to carry paid/Miro rubber stamp. Date on MIRO Stamp and Petty cash voucher must be same.

3)  Any purchases for our store consumption to carry "Goods Inward with date received Stamp and round Security Stamp and date" with proper signatures. This is also applicable for articles purchased from store, including HK articles, for store consumption.
1) Accounts to settle 1%  with SRT within 24hrs. Weekly Off/ Holidays to be exempted.
2) Accounts to sign in 1%  register with date & time.
1) Accounts to settle Rate Difference  with SRT within 24hrs. Weekly Off/ Holidays to be exempted.
2) Accounts to sign in Rate Difference  register with date & time.
